_comment: Named bits of a battle slot's nine status bytes, wBattleStatus ... wBattleStatus8 (stride 9; D-009). 'forced' means tools/status_check.py set the bit for every slot in a debug battle and the listed battle texts appeared (E-0339, C2); 'set by' means the bit is set by that skill's effect routine, whose skill is C2 from E-0333 (reading of the routine, C2). tools/disasm_all.py writes them to src/constants.inc as BSTAT<byte>_<NAME> and uses them in bit/set/res on [hl] after `ld hl, wBattleStatusN` and AddAx9ToHL.

bits.name: POISONED
bits.note: forced: '0 suffers from poison! 0 lost ... HP'

bits.name: BADLY_POISONED
bits.note: forced: '0 is wracked by poison!', '0 dropped dead!'

bits.name: SLEEP_TURNS_LO
bits.note: low bit of a 2-bit sleep counter: ActionEffect_Sleep sets bits 7, 3 and 2 together (or $8C); ActionEffect_ActionBF tests bits 2-3 ($0C) (E-0346 reading, C1)

bits.name: SLEEP_TURNS_HI
bits.note: high bit of the sleep counter with bit 2 (or $8C in ActionEffect_Sleep) (E-0346 reading, C1)

bits.name: CONFUSED
bits.note: forced: '0 is confused!', '0 snapped out of confusion!'; set by PanicAll

bits.name: CURSED
bits.note: forced: '0 is cursed! 0 can't move!', '0 is cursed! 0 lost ... HP!'

bits.name: PARALYZED
bits.note: set by ActionEffect_ActionC6 with resolve message $76 '0 became paralyzed!'; tested by ActionEffect_PalsyAir and when the actor's command is resolved (E-0346 reading, C1)

bits.name: ASLEEP
bits.note: forced: '0 woke up!'

bits.name: SPELLS_SEALED
bits.note: set by StopSpell

bits.name: BLINDED
bits.note: set when RollVsRadiantResistance succeeds; ActionEffect_Radiant and ActionEffect_SandStorm skip a target that has it; forced: 'Miss! 0 avoided damage!' (E-0346 reading, C1)

bits.name: ATK_DOUBLED
bits.note: set by ActionEffect_TwinHits (once; resolve message $43 '0's ATK doubled!') and ActionEffect_ActionDD; the AI checks it with ActorLacksStatus1Bit2 (E-0346 reading, C1)

bits.name: CRITICAL
bits.note: forced: 'Critical hit!', 'A brutal hit!'

bits.name: DRAGON_FORM
bits.note: set by BeDragon

bits.name: TRANSFORMED
bits.note: set by Transform; DeMagic clears bits 4-5 with '0 turned back to normal!' (E-0337)

bits.name: DANCE_SEALED
bits.note: set by DanceShut

bits.name: BREATH_SEALED
bits.note: set by MouthShut

bits.name: TAKE_MAGIC
bits.note: set and tested by ActionEffect_TakeMagic; the AI checks it before TakeMagic (E-0346 reading, C1)

bits.name: BOUNCE
bits.note: a lasting spell bounce: TryWallOfLightBounce bounces when bit 1 or 5 is set ($22) and keeps bit 5 only when bit 1 is set; ChooseTarget_Beat, _Sap and _Slow skip targets with it (E-0346 reading, C1)

bits.name: DAMAGE_HALVED
bits.note: HalveDamageIfTargetStatus2Bit2 halves the damage to a target with it (E-0346 reading, C1)

bits.name: AQUA_WALL
bits.note: set by AquaWall

bits.name: UNUSED_2_4
bits.note: no static reader or writer found (bit/set/res on the status byte, masks after AddAx9ToHL); forcing it showed no new battle text (E-0346 reading, C1)

bits.name: MAGIC_BACK
bits.note: a one-time spell bounce: TryWallOfLightBounce clears it after bouncing unless bit 1 is set; tested by ActionEffect_MagicBack (E-0346 reading, C1)

bits.name: WIND_GUARD
bits.note: set by TailWind; TryWindBounce: 'The wind around 0 bounced the attack!', DeMagic: 'The wind around 0 died!' (E-0337)

bits.name: CRITICAL_ROLLED
bits.note: ResolveStepCriticalRoll sets it on the actor when the critical roll succeeds ('Critical hit!' / 'A brutal hit!') and clears it otherwise; ResolveStepComputeDamage then uses ATK within 5% as the damage; Berserker, EvilSlash, Massacre and TwinSlash clear it (E-0346 reading, C1)

bits.name: FROZEN
bits.note: forced: '0 is frozen solid!'

bits.name: DANCING
bits.note: forced: '0 is dancing along!'

bits.name: TRIPPED
bits.note: forced: '0 can't get back up!'

bits.name: SHIVERING
bits.note: forced: '0 is shivering!'

bits.name: COWERING
bits.note: forced: '0 is cowering in fear!'

bits.name: VACANT
bits.note: forced: '0 looks vacant and lost!'

bits.name: AIRBORNE
bits.note: forced: '0 fell out of the sky!', '0 landed safely!'

bits.name: AIRBORNE_HI
bits.note: high bit of a 2-bit field with AIRBORNE (byte 3 is tested with and $C0 in about 40 places; ActionEffect_ActionC9 and _ActionBF clear both); forced: 'But it failed to reach 0!', '0 fell out of the sky!', '0 landed awkwardly!' (E-0346 reading, C1)

bits.name: CHARGE_UP
bits.note: set (with bit 1) by ChargeUp

bits.name: CHARGE_UP_HI
bits.note: set with bit 0 by ActionEffect_ChargeUp (or $03); ActorLacksStatus4Bits01 tests both (E-0346 reading, C1)

bits.name: HIGH_JUMP
bits.note: ForcedActionForActorStatus forces action $CC (HighJump) when it is set; SetSubPhase2AndRestartResolve clears bits 2-3 for action $CC when they equal 1; forced: 'But it failed to reach 0!' (E-0346 reading, C1)

bits.name: HIGH_JUMP_HI
bits.note: high bit of the 2-bit field with HIGH_JUMP ($0C, cleared by TryShuntOrGuard and ActionEffect_ActionC9); forced: '0 fell out of the sky!', 'But it failed to reach 0!' (E-0346 reading, C1)

bits.name: SUCK_AIR
bits.note: set (with bit 5) by SuckAir

bits.name: SUCK_AIR_HI
bits.note: set with bit 4 by ActionEffect_SuckAir (or $30); ActorLacksStatus4Bits45 tests both (E-0346 reading, C1)

bits.name: FOCUS_LO
bits.note: low bit of the 2-bit field with FOCUS (ActorLacksStatus4Bits67 tests $C0); RunBattleActions tests and clears it when the actor's action starts (E-0346 reading, C1)

bits.name: FOCUS
bits.note: set by Focus

bits.name: RADIANT_BLIND
bits.note: ActionEffect_Radiant (D = 1) has no effect on a target with it, and ORs D into this byte when it blinds; the AI tests it with BLINDED (E-0346 reading, C1)

bits.name: SANDSTORM_BLIND
bits.note: ActionEffect_SandStorm (D = 2) has no effect on a target with it, and ORs D into this byte when it blinds (E-0346 reading, C1)

bits.name: SIDE_STEP
bits.note: the SideStep field (bits 2-3, and $0C, tested by the AI before SideStep); cleared by ClearTargetStatus5Bits23And7Bits012 (WarCry, Ahhh, LegSweep ...); forced: '0 leapt out of the way!' (E-0346 reading, C1)

bits.name: SIDE_STEP_HI
bits.note: high bit of the SideStep field; forced: '0 leapt out of the way!' (E-0346 reading, C1)

bits.name: SONG_FORCED
bits.note: ForcedActionForActorStatus forces action $CE when it is set; ActionEffect_LifeSong takes its second path when it is set and otherwise starts the song (LIFE_SONG) (E-0346 reading, C1)

bits.name: LIFE_SONG
bits.note: forced: '0's song ended!', '0 came back to life!'

bits.name: IRONIZED
bits.note: forced: '0 is a hunk of iron!', '0's Ironize wore off!' (bit 7 the same)

bits.name: IRONIZE_TURNS_HI
bits.note: high bit of the Ironize turn count with IRONIZED: the wear-off step subtracts $40 each turn and shows '0's Ironize wore off!' at zero (E-0346 reading, C1)

bits.name: CALLED_HELP
bits.note: 'Help arrived from seemingly nowhere!', 'The help went away!' (E-0339 reading)

bits.name: SUCK_ALL
bits.note: set by SuckAll; '0 blew back G!'

bits.name: BERSERK
bits.note: set by Berserker

bits.name: IMITATE
bits.note: set by Imitate; forced: '0 struck back!'

bits.name: GUARDED
bits.note: an ally guards this slot (TryAllyGuard, E-0337)

bits.name: DODGE
bits.note: set by Dodge; forced: '0 shunted the attack!'

bits.name: STATS_RAISED
bits.note: set through SetSlotStatus6Bit6 by ActionEffect_Speed, _Upper and _ActionDD; DefeatTarget resets AGL and DEF to base when bit 6 or 7 is set (E-0346 reading, C1)

bits.name: STATS_LOWERED
bits.note: set through SetSlotStatus6Bit7 by ActionEffect_LushLicks, _UltraDown and the damage message step; DefeatTarget resets AGL and DEF to base when bit 6 or 7 is set (E-0346 reading, C1)

bits.name: GUARD
bits.note: set by Guard

bits.name: DAMAGE_X10
bits.note: the damage message step multiplies the damage to a target with it by 10 (bit 0: x2, bit 2: x2) and then clears bits 0-3; ActionEffect_ActionE2 sets it for every slot on the actor's side (E-0346 reading, C1)

bits.name: COUNTER
bits.note: forced: '0's counterstrike!', '0 couldn't retaliate!'

bits.name: DAMAGE_DOUBLED
bits.note: the reaction step doubles the damage to a target with it (E-0346 reading, C1)

bits.name: UNUSED_7_4
bits.note: no static reader or writer found; the damage message step keeps bits 4-7 (and $F0); forcing it showed no new battle text (E-0346 reading, C1)

bits.name: UNUSED_7_5
bits.note: no static reader or writer found; forcing it showed no new battle text (E-0346 reading, C1)

bits.name: UNUSED_7_6
bits.note: no static reader or writer found; forcing it showed no new battle text (E-0346 reading, C1)

bits.name: UNUSED_7_7
bits.note: no static reader or writer found; forcing it showed no new battle text (E-0346 reading, C1)

bits.name: LOVE_RAIN_FORCED
bits.note: ForcedActionForActorStatus forces action $CF when it is set; ActionEffect_LoveRain takes its second path when it is set (E-0346 reading, C1)

bits.name: LOVE_RAIN
bits.note: set by ActionEffect_LoveRain with a random heal amount in wHealFlags; forced: 'A gentle rain fell!', '0's wound was healed!' (E-0346 reading, C1)

bits.name: UNUSED_8_2
bits.note: no static reader or writer found; forcing it showed no new battle text (E-0346 reading, C1)

bits.name: UNUSED_8_3
bits.note: no static reader or writer found; forcing it showed no clear new battle text (E-0346 reading, C1)

bits.name: SEAL_PRAY
bits.note: set by SealPray; forced: 'SealPray was broken!'

bits.name: UNUSED_8_5
bits.note: no static reader or writer found; forcing it showed no new battle text (E-0346 reading, C1)

bits.name: MAGIC_WALL
bits.note: set by MagicWall

bits.name: EERIE_LITE
bits.note: set by EerieLite
